name: Moises
summary: App for musicians to separate stems, remove vocals, practise, master and remix tracks.
description: Moises is a toolkit for musicians that separates songs into stems such as vocals, drums and bass, detects chords and tempo, and supports practice, mastering and remixing. Moises Studio adds collaborative music making. It runs on the web, desktop and mobile.

howToUse.title: Open Moises in the browser, or download the desktop or mobile app, and sign up.
howToUse.description: Open Moises in the browser, or download the desktop or mobile app, and sign up.

howToUse.title: Upload a song.
howToUse.description: Upload a song. Moises separates it into stems such as vocals, drums and bass so you can mute the part you play.

howToUse.title: Use the musicians' toolkit as it detects chords and tempo, then practice, master or remix...
howToUse.description: Use the musicians' toolkit as it detects chords and tempo, then practice, master or remix the track.

howToUse.description: Start a Moises Studio session for collaborative music making: arrange, record and edit the same session with other people in the browser.

features: App for musicians to separate stems, remove vocals, practise, master and remix tracks.
Moises is a toolkit for musicians that separates songs into stems such as vocals, drums and bass, detects chords and tempo, and supports practice, mastering and remixing.
Moises Studio adds collaborative music making.
It runs on the web, desktop and mobile.
features_fr: Application permettant aux musiciens de séparer les stems, de supprimer les voix, de s'entraîner, de masteriser et de remixer les pistes.

Moises est une boîte à outils pour les musiciens qui sépare les chansons en segments tels que le chant, la batterie et la basse, détecte les accords et le tempo et prend en charge la pratique, le mastering et le remix.
Moises Studio ajoute la création musicale collaborative.
Il fonctionne sur le Web, sur ordinateur et sur mobile.
